shortDescription: Module to interact with rapyuta_io networks

options.name: network_interface
options.description: network_interface used by the I(runtim=device) in I(type=routed_network) or I(type=native_network). Is case Insensitive.

options.name: present
options.description: Whether the network should be present in rapyuta.io.

options.name: resource_type
options.description: Resource type needed for the I(type=native_network) and I(runtime=cloud) of I(type=routed_network). Required if I(type=native_network). Is case Insensitive.

options.name: restart_policy
options.description: Restart policy for I(runtime=device) of I(type=routed_network). Is case Insensitive.

options.name: ros_distro
options.description: Ros Distro to be used for the native_network. Required if I(type=native_network). Is case Insensitive.

options.name: runtime
options.description: runtime for I(type=routed_network). Is case Insensitive.

options.name: shared
options.description: Whether the I(type=routed_network) should be shared. Is case Insensitive.

options.name: type
options.description: Can be used to deploy either static routes, native_networks or routed_networks.
